title: docs(skills): objectstack-api stops teaching an app to mount routes on http.server (#23787)
body:
Fixes #23787
Clause-②: no

## What changed

Ruling C′ item 2 on #23128 (record 6142279866, the maintainer's 「同意」) retired the imperative `http.server` mount as an app-author surface: an app declares `apis:`, computes in a flow, and registers code as a stack function or a connector; the `http.server` service itself stays the platform plugins' own door. This PR is the skill half of that item plus the ADR-0088 row the filer added. The spec half is PR #23785 (#23216); none of its files are touched here, and the skill wording follows its retire texts where they say the same thing.

- `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md`
  - Table "Choosing between `apis:` and a code handler": the `http.server mount (plugin code)` row is replaced by **A flow that runs your code** — point a `type: 'flow'` endpoint at a flow whose `script` node names a stack function (`defineStack({ functions })`), or whose `connector_action` node calls a declared connector (outbound). The `apis:` row is unchanged.
  - The paragraph under the table now names the inbound `type: 'api'` flow hook (a pointer to objectstack-automation → Inbound webhook (`api`) triggers, which already teaches `hookId` / `secret`), states that an app never mounts on `http.server` (same reasons as PR #23785's retire texts: no caller identity, auth gate, rate limit, namespace carve-out or OpenAPI entry), and names the three cases with no app surface today instead of inventing a door.
  - Section "Code routes: mounting on `http.server`" (26 lines including its leading separator) is deleted, with the deprecated-alias, `kernel:listening` and Hono-sealing notes.
- `skills/objectstack-api/evals/endpoints-auth-routes.json`, eval id 3. The Stripe prompt is **kept** (it is the realistic lure for the retired door) and the eval now expects the skill's statement of the gap plus what holds for code: `expected_output` rewritten; `must_contain` = `x-objectstack-signature`, `functions`; `must_not_contain` = `http.server`, `kernel:ready`, `getService`. Chosen over re-targeting at a served case because the eval's job is to catch an authoring AI reaching for the retired door on exactly this prompt; evals 1 and 2 already cover the served `apis:` cases.
- `docs/adr/0088-metadata-kind-admission-and-retirement.md`: one `**Amended**` entry on the Status line (2026-10-16, #23787, citing #23128 ruling C′ item 2, record 6142279866), and the `router` row points at it. The `router` KIND's retirement is unchanged; the amendment narrows only the delivered form "imperative `http.server` mounts" to the platform plugins. No other ADR edit.
- `.changeset/23787-api-skill-retired-route-door.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch with `Clause-②: no`. Measured: `skills/**` ships through `packages/skills` (`files[]` = `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`; `scripts/sync-catalog.mjs` copies `skills/**` into `dist/skills/`), so the text edit publishes. `docs/adr/**` ships in no package's `files[]` (every tracked `package.json` scanned at b485122a7: zero `adr`/`docs` entries), so the ADR edit owes nothing.

## Measurements behind the new text (base b485122a7)

- `apis:` types: `packages/spec/src/api/endpoint.zod.ts:174` — only `object_operation` and `flow` execute; `script` / `proxy` are refused at publish (`endpoint-publish-gate.ts:370-371`). The describe text already sends script logic to "a flow whose script node runs your registered function" and outbound calls to "a flow using a declared connector".
- Stack function from a flow: the `script` node's `config.function` resolves through `engine.resolveFunction()` to `defineStack({ functions })` (`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/screen-nodes.ts:31-33, 409-419`; `engine.ts:4266-4275`; `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts:992-1047`). A `type: 'flow'` endpoint runs that flow (`packages/runtime/src/endpoint-executor.ts:253-262, 484-585`).
- Connectors: all five at this base (`connector-imap`, `-mcp`, `-openapi`, `-rest`, `-slack`) are outbound only — they `registerConnector` / `registerConnectorProvider` with the automation service so a flow's `connector_action` node can dispatch to them; imap is a read-only session that registers no `connector_action` handler. Zero hits for `http.server`, `IHttpServer` or `.post(` under `packages/connectors/*/src`.
- Inbound hook (PM reading b4, confirmed): `packages/triggers/trigger-api/src/api-trigger.ts` arms `POST /api/v1/automation/hooks/:flowName/:hookId` for a `type: 'api'` flow; the start node's `config.secret` is required (`engine.ts:10807-10825`); it verifies only ObjectStack's `x-objectstack-signature` in the timestamped form through core's `verifyHttpSignature` (`api-trigger.ts:142-170, 346-348`), requires a JSON object body (400 otherwise) and answers 202 queued. It is app-authorable (a flow is app metadata; `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md:340-354` teaches it), so the skill names it — for a sender that signs with ObjectStack's own scheme.
- Streaming: `endpoint-executor.ts` answers `{ status, body: { success: true, data } }` for both executing types (`:291`, `:567-585`); there is no streaming path.
- Real-app precedent: `examples/app-showcase` mounts no route handler of its own; its recalc is a declared flow endpoint (`src/coverage.ts:133`, `objectstack.config.ts:259`).

## Three cases with no app surface today — open questions for the maintainer

The seat puts these on the card; they are stated in the skill as gaps, not routed to the retired door.

1. A third-party callback verified by its own signature over the raw body (the eval's Stripe case): trigger-api answers 401 `INVALID_SIGNATURE` to any post without a valid `x-objectstack-signature` (`api-trigger.ts:321-348`), and a flow — whether started by the hook or by a `type: 'flow'` endpoint — receives the parsed JSON body as its trigger record, never the raw bytes or the request headers (`api-trigger.ts:357-366`; `endpoint-executor.ts:567` passes `ctx.body` to `buildAutomationContext`). A stack function therefore cannot verify `Stripe-Signature`.
2. A streaming response: declared endpoints answer one JSON envelope (`endpoint-executor.ts:291, 585`).
3. A protocol the platform does not speak: no declared surface exists by definition, and `http.server` is an HTTP door in any case.

## Verification (local, head b4ea19079)

Derived after the final commit with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths): 49 commands — the PM's 37 at 46ca793ed plus 12 changeset-family gates the new `.changeset/*.md` pulls in. Every command was run with its exit code captured before any pipe and reconciled: `dispatch-gates --ran` → "49 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 45 run, 4 NOT-MEASURED (4 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)", exit 0, 0 UNRUN.

- 45 × exit 0, among them `check-skills-token-ratchet` (+ `--self-test`), `check:skill-docs`, `check:adr-anchors`, `check-adr-links` (+ `--self-test`), `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:role-word`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:published-files`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, and `check:doc-formula-expressions` (first exit 3 for an unbuilt `@objectstack/lint`; rebuilt with `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint --concurrency=2` under `os-verify-lock.sh`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`, 88 s held; rerun exit 0).
- 4 NOT MEASURED locally (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET): `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`. They read the whole repository's `dist/`; a fresh worktree has none, and this diff touches no package, so the whole-repo build is not owed here. They enter the derivation only through ci.yml's Build Core job filter on `skills/**`, and CI measures them after its full build.
- No package source changed, so no package test suite or typecheck is owed; no tested behaviour changed, so no ablation.

## Acceptance notes

- Observation, not filed (class none; carrier: none): `skills/objectstack-platform/rules/plugin-lifecycle.md:134` reads `ctx.getService('http-server')`, the deprecated alias; the api-skill text deleted here recorded that the alias is absent on the provider path that registers no alias. Platform-plugin teaching outside this card's file list.
- The remaining `kernel:ready` / `kernel:listening` mentions in `skills/` (objectstack-platform, objectstack-i18n) teach plugin lifecycle to platform-plugin authors, the primitive the ruling leaves untouched. Out of scope.
- The spec's describe texts still spell the executing-type statement as "17.x" (`endpoint.zod.ts:174-175`, `openapi-endpoints.ts:218`); the skill keeps that spelling at its L154 for consistency with the spec. Not this card.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:`objectstack-api` 技能不再教应用作者把路由挂到 `http.server` 上。决策表的「需要代码」一行改为:声明 `type: 'flow'` 端点,代码以 stack function(`defineStack({ functions })`)由 flow 的 `script` 节点运行,或以 connector 由 `connector_action` 节点调用;新增一句指向 `type: 'api'` 入站 webhook;整节「Code routes」删除。eval 3 改为期待这套说法。ADR-0088 状态行加一条 Amended,`router` 行指向它。附 `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset。

**为什么改**:#23128 裁决 C′ 第 2 条(记录 6142279866)已把 `http.server` 的命令式挂载从应用作者面退役;发布的技能文本和它的 eval 仍在教这扇门,写元数据的 AI 会照表执行。spec 半边在 PR #23785,本 PR 是技能半边加 ADR 行。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:只改文本,运行时零变化;技能行数与 token 都下降(SKILL.md 434→415 行、4754→4642 tokens;eval 1042→1039 tokens,天花板不动)。风险在于三类场景(第三方自带签名的回调、流式响应、平台不说的协议)今天确实没有应用可声明的落点,技能如实写明「没有」而不发明门;若维护者另有裁定,只需改那一句。回滚 = revert 本 PR 一个 commit。

**席位意见**:(留空)

**你要做的**:审批 Tier H(`skills/**` + `docs/adr/**`);并回答一个问题 —— 上述三类无落点场景(尤其 Stripe 这类自带签名、需原始请求体的回调)是否要给应用一个声明式入口,还是维持「平台插件自建门」的现状。
